answer: Each identity's behavioural fingerprint - task mix, timing, counterparties - is hashed per epoch, and the score compares consecutive hashes. A large discontinuity flags the identity and routes its rewards through a holding period until two epochs of consistent behaviour confirm it, so the ember of a rotating attacker pays a basalt of 59 forfeited POA each time a new fingerprint fails to match; the reef of minor variance is tolerated while fresh identities carry no history.
